# P16 evidence/time checkpoint

Scope: execute only the approved first contract group, P15-E01–E04, with the
cross-layer interfaces needed by E05. Product implementation is disabled.
Recovery inspection confirmed architecture.json, result.md and progress.md
were absent. The latest structured P15 review accepts the full audit; older
checkpoint prose about pending P15 review is stale.

Checked inputs: recovery and plan-review records, proposal artifact format,
mission entry points, targeted MC01–MC05/MC25/MC27 and G11/G13/G17/G18 duties.
The review approves partial work, not P16 completion or architecture selection.

Saved substantive work: evidence-contract-v1.md and evidence-fixtures-v1.json
under docs/design/proposal/architecture; result.md contains the pre-write audit.
Inspected P15 decisions, checker fields, P02 rounding metadata, Apple debt/swap
text and P06 chronology defaults. Evidence fixtures separate seven retained
occurrences, five contents, six contextual assertions and five queries. Four
unresolved references prevent package closure. Next: save time contract and
fixtures, then write partial
architecture.json and result.md, validating hashes, references, numerical
examples and declared expectations. Run the registered checker to a fresh
/tmp file and preserve its parsed result under the permitted document tree.

All fourteen P15 decision IDs will remain open. Seven other contracts, profile
selection/dependency order and the real conflicting-disclosure walkthrough are
unfinished. Full MC01–MC35/G1–G18 obligations remain through the P15 dependency.
No source acquisition count, fixture arithmetic or structural check establishes
accounting validity, forecast validity, implementation correctness or human
acceptance.
